title: 第2797章 共三人故人之姿第2796章 寻地道显出真身
content_zh:
“哈哈哈，这并非是我一人之功，这是我们众人联合的成果，等拿下了这小畜生，所有人都重重有赏。”
被手下人一阵吹捧，这钦天剑宗的大长老也有些飘飘然了起来。
他狂笑了两声，随即锐利的目光再度落在了那地道的入口。
“小畜生，老夫已经知道你藏在这地道之中了，还不现身？非要老夫亲自出手不成？”
大长老一脸振奋的隔空叫喊。
整个矿脉都已经被他围困得水泄不通了，在他看来周山南就是他的掌中之物。
而他周围的那些弟子们，瞧见地道之中迟迟都没有什么动静传来，都是摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试。
想着进入地洞之中，帮大长老将人抓出来。
就在他们即将有所行动的时候，地道之中传来了回应。
“老狗，你这狗鼻子倒是够灵敏的，小爷跑了这么远你还闻着味过来了，不容易啊。”
一道爽朗的声音传来，紧接着所有人就见，在距离那地道入口不远处的一块平地忽然嘭的一声炸开。
接着一道人影就从中飞了出来。
这是一个模样还算俊俏的少年，身上袍服些许碎裂，沾染着不少的血迹，看起来似乎是受了伤。
而在这少年之后，地洞之中居然又出现了两道身影。
一个是毛发极为旺盛的年轻人，另一个是身着紫衣，看起来不过十六七岁的女子。
这女子长相清纯，气质出众，哪怕未曾长成，却已经是有了沉鱼落雁之姿。
在这三人出现的瞬间，全场所有人的目光全都落在了他们的身上。
钦天剑宗的人惊喜。
客卿长老则是惊愕。
他是真的没有料到，钦天剑宗的人真的藏在他们矿场，对此他是一无所知的。

而此刻藏在暗处的江若尘瞧见眼前的一幕，也是微微惊讶了一下。
他虽然事先已经有了心理准备，可当真的看到之时，还是不免有些惊讶。
这人不是别人，正是自己的弟子周阳。
“哈哈哈，若尘师弟，周阳这家伙跟你当年真是如出一辙啊，不仅能惹祸，这祸害别人家姑娘的本事也不比你小。”
屠穹则是在短暂的惊讶之后，立马是小声地调侃了起来。
他之所以这样开口，自然是注意到了周阳身后的那清纯女子。
那女子身份谁都不知道，但从两人的站位来看，关系似乎走的非常近。
江若尘听到这话自然是无语。
但也没有多说什么，决定继续观望一下，看看自己这个弟子在绝境之中，究竟会表现出什么样的秉性来。
以及他身边的那两人，到底是个什么身份。
“哈哈哈哈，周山南，果真是你，可让老夫一番好找啊。”
面对周阳的辱骂，大长老丝毫不生气，甚至反倒哈哈大笑了起来，看向周阳的眼神，满是贪婪。
“周山南，老夫是极为爱才的，你是个可造之材，老夫不愿意杀你，眼下依旧是可以给你一个机会，拜入我的门下，成为亲传弟子，之前的事情老夫不仅可以既往不咎。”
“我钦天剑宗还可以全力培养你，如何？”
“机会只有这一次，你可要好好的把握，若是再拒绝，你也休怪老夫心狠手辣，将你斩杀于此了。”
大长老狂笑着抛出了橄榄枝。
content_en:
"Hahaha, this is not the result of me alone, it is the result of the joint efforts of all of us. Once we take down this little beast, everyone will be heavily rewarded."
After being praised by his subordinates for a while, the great elder of Qintian Sword Sect also became a little proud.
He laughed wildly twice, and then his sharp eyes fell on the entrance of the tunnel again.
"Little beast, I already know that you are hiding in this tunnel, and you still haven't shown up? Do you have to take action personally?"
The great elder shouted from the air with an excited look on his face.
The entire mineral vein has been besieged by him, and in his opinion, Zhou Shannan is in the palm of his hand.
The disciples around him saw that there was no movement in the tunnel, and they were all gearing up and eager to try.
Thinking of entering the cave and helping the great elder catch the people.
Just when they were about to take action, a response came from the tunnel.
"Old dog, your dog's nose is quite sensitive. It's not easy for you to smell the smell after I ran so far."
A hearty voice came, and then everyone saw that a piece of flat land not far from the tunnel entrance suddenly exploded with a bang.
Then a figure flew out from it.
This was a fairly handsome young man. His robe was slightly torn and stained with a lot of blood. He seemed to be injured.
And after this young man, two more figures actually appeared in the cave.
One is a young man with extremely thick hair, and the other is a woman in purple clothes who looks to be no more than sixteen or seventeen years old.
This woman has a pure appearance and outstanding temperament. Even though she has not grown up, she already has the appearance of a fish and a wild goose.
The moment these three people appeared, everyone's eyes fell on them.
The people of Qintian Sword Sect were pleasantly surprised.
Elder Keqing was shocked.
He really didn't expect that people from the Qintian Sword Sect were really hiding in their mine, and he knew nothing about it.
Jiang Ruochen, who was hiding in the dark at the moment, was slightly surprised when he saw the scene in front of him.
Although he had been mentally prepared beforehand, he was still a little surprised when he actually saw it.
This person is none other than his disciple Zhou Yang.
"Hahaha, Junior Brother Ruochen, this guy Zhou Yang is exactly the same as you back then. Not only can he cause trouble, but he is also as capable of causing trouble to other girls as you are."
Tu Qiong, after being briefly surprised, immediately started teasing in a low voice.
The reason why he spoke like this was naturally because he noticed the pure woman behind Zhou Yang.
No one knew the identity of the woman, but judging from their positions, it seemed that they were very close.
Jiang Ruochen was naturally speechless when he heard this.
But he didn't say anything more, and decided to continue to wait and see to see what kind of character his disciple would show in a desperate situation.
And what are the identities of the two people beside him.
"Hahahaha, Zhou Shannan, it's really you. It's really easy for me to find you."
Faced with Zhou Yang's insults, the great elder was not angry at all, and even laughed out loud, looking at Zhou Yang with eyes full of greed.
"Zhou Shannan, I love talents very much. You are a talented person. I don't want to kill you. I can still give you a chance to join my sect and become my direct disciple. Not only can I forget about the past."
"Our Qintian Sword Sect can still train you with all our strength, how about that?"
"You only have this opportunity, so you have to seize it. If you refuse again, don't blame me for being ruthless and killing you here."
The great elder laughed wildly and extended an olive branch.
